title: {{APP}}: Learn French
short: Learn French vocabulary offline with a daily word and spaced repetition.
full:
{{APP}} helps you learn French vocabulary and key grammar, one word a day, entirely offline.

Every day you get one French word at your CEFR level (A1 to C2): the article, the pronunciation, the meaning, an example sentence and a short cultural note. The word bank holds {{WORDS}} words.

• Save words to your vault and review them with spaced repetition: words you know come back later, words you miss come back sooner.
• Review in several formats: typed fill-in-the-blank, rebuilding a sentence from tiles, multiple choice, matching pairs and flashcards.
• Practise any time in the format you choose, without touching your review schedule.
• Drill grammar: choose the right article (le or la), pick avoir or être as the auxiliary of the passé composé, the right direct object pronoun among le, la, les, and qui or que.
• Listen to words and sentences read aloud by your phone's text-to-speech.
• Optional daily reminders, a learning streak and statistics.
• Back up your data to a file and restore it on another phone.

Free, with no ads and no account. Your learning data stays on your device, and the app works fully offline.

Optional AI notes: if you add your own API key from a supported provider, {{APP}} can ask it for extra examples and a usage note for a word. This is off by default; only the word, its level and your app language are sent, straight to the provider you chose.

{{APP}} is available in {{UI_LANGS}} app languages and runs on Android.
